$582,400

Gainesville, MO, 65655 , Gainesville, MO 65655(Ozark County)

Size: 208 Acres
Type: Recreational Property, Timberland Property, Hunting Property

Ozark County l 208 Acres l Mature Hardwoods, Live Water & Open Ground

This 208 +/- acre tract is a hardwood paradise with a year-round flowing creek running through it. Big trees, open spaces, and water close by make this property rich with wildlife, offering great deer and turkey hunting along with habitat for all kinds of other game. It's secluded with county road frontage, located just 7 miles from Gainesville, MO and about 1.5 hours from Springfield, MO.

The tract features 137 +/- acres of mature hardwoods along with a 27 +/- acre greenfield, giving you the perfect mix of cover, food, and water that wildlife thrive on. Whether you're looking for a serious hunting property, a timber investment, or just a secluded piece to call your own, this tract checks all the boxes.
